title: Create vixen_stage_assets stamp directory before touching stamp
body: On the base, the queued full build failed because the stamp parent build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets did not exist. VIXEN/cmake/VixenAssets.cmake:57 writes the stamp there but only creates the asset destination. I ran mkdir -p build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets, then the same queued cmake --build build passed. Have the staging command create its stamp parent.

title: Provide UNDERTOW_ROOT to consumer-dependent CodegenTool tests
body: The queued CodegenTool test run without UNDERTOW_ROOT failed eight consumer fixture tests. The suite passed after setting UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow. Add a documented default or test runner that supplies the sibling consumer root for tests that require it.

title: Resolve the root build directory for nested VIXEN regen targets
body: The queued command cmake --build build --target view_editor_layers_regen appflow_regen failed when run from the nested VIXEN directory because that directory has no build subdirectory. The identical target command passed from the worktree root where build lives. Make regen entry points root-aware or document a stable VIXEN-relative build path.

title: Expose a canonical VDC artifact regeneration target
body: To update the kernel-generated VoxelDocument.g.h and sample document, I had to run the emitter test with UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 and manually copy both outputs into VIXEN. Add a supported generator target that writes the consumer artifacts from the canonical kernel schema and removes this hand-copy step.

title: Serialize DZN-backed CTest workloads under parallel runs
body: The queued ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -L RenderGraph -j4 run on WSL scheduled vixen_editor_capture_producer alongside B1 and other GPU tests; D3D12 removed the device, the editor capture then failed in FrameSyncNode fence wait, and three other GPU tests aborted. With the same tree and DZN ICD, the full suite at -j1 passed 1341/1341. Add a CTest GPU resource lock so -j4 can keep CPU checks parallel while serializing DZN-backed processes, and keep the canonical runner's login-shell ICD setup.

title: Give VIXEN CMake configure a light queue reservation
body: The queued cmake -S VIXEN -B build configure under --resource build remained pending on a 17 GB class-max memory reservation and was cancelled with exit 130 before CMake started. The same configure under the documented --resource light queue completed in 11 seconds. Classify configure-only work with a light reservation so it does not wait behind native compilation reservations while preserving build/test admission for actual heavy commands.

title: Set Vulkan runtime paths on headless starfield CTest captures
body: The 11-case capture CTest selection with DISPLAY, VK_* variables, and LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset failed HeadlessStarfieldGraph.CaptureFirst and CaptureSecond with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER; CompareIndependentCaptures then saw empty output files (exit 8, log /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1791460950-test-run2-captures-11.log). VIXEN/application/main/tests/test_headless_starfield_graph.cmake sets capture and feature variables but omits VIXEN_CTEST_GPU_ENVIRONMENT. Exporting the configured Mesa, X11, and Vulkan loader directories in LD_LIBRARY_PATH while keeping DISPLAY and VK_* unset made the same selection pass 11/11. Apply the shared CTest GPU runtime environment to these headless app tests.
